MERIDIAN INDUSTRIAL GROUP — ORGNI HARD-TEST PACK
All people, organisations, addresses, banking details and events are fictional.

Contents:
- documents/: 40 source documents in PDF, DOCX, XLSX, CSV, TXT, HTML, JSON, XML, PPTX and PNG
- manifest.json: file purpose, format and expected extraction scenario links
- ground_truth.json: expected ontology entities, relationships, facts, policies, conflicts and provenance

Recommended evaluation:
1. Ingest all files without using ground_truth.json.
2. Compare normalized Orgni output to ground_truth.json.
3. Score entity resolution, relationship precision, fact accuracy, temporal correction, policy detection, conflict detection and provenance.
